text:
maria: Heads up — Acme reported that when we fall back from model-redwood-large to model-redwood-small due to capacity, their tenant quota didn't apply. Can we confirm?

aj: not expected. routing should be after auth+quota check. sending logs.

sam: that's serious — could be effective-scope mismatch where fallback model isn't bound to tenant-scoped policy.

teja: telemetry shows ~0.6% of requests with fallback header had "quota_not_applied" events between 03:00-06:00 UTC. digging.

julia: UX: console should show per-route "fallback allowed" toggle + explain the quota impact. customers ask for transparency.

ken: quick idea: in routing decision include effective_scope in trace headers so audits can link final model to token scope.

aj: prototype header suggestion:
```
X-Redwood-Requested-Scope: tenant:acme:write
X-Redwood-Effective-Scope: tenant:acme:write;model:redwood-small
```

sam: audit events we need: token_validation, scope_resolution, routing_decision(model=...,fallback=true/false), quota_applied(true/false), quota_deduction(amount).

teja: canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with alert if quota_applied rate < 99.9% within 10m. tie to SLO.

maria: agree. Product wants console flag to opt-out of fallback per-tenant. Also need a per-route explanation in the role editor that fallback can affect quotas.

julia: I'll draft microcopy and telemetry event doc. need sample API response snippet for console to display.

aj: implementation note: validate scopes against model-variants map before routing; if mismatch, reject unless token has a fallback:allow claim. We'll add header `X-Redwood-Fallback-Allowed: true`. Minimal change to runtime routing order.

ops-bot: deploy queued for canary branch infra/canary/perm-routing-2026-03-20 by @aj.

ken: one more — update our SDKs to surface `effective_scope` in response metadata and make it filterable in console logs (search by effective_scope).

sam: add audit logging to key management interactions too (Private deployments + KMS/HSM) — we should tie model key usage to tenant scope in the audit.

maria: timeline: canary tomorrow, docs + console flag next week. proceeding.

aj: ack

julia: ack :thumbsup:
